{{Quote|Gaahh! The mindless pit droids are running loose! They are released by Launchers like this one here.|Watto|<ref name="Star Wars: Pit Droids">''[[Star Wars: Pit Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''Launchers''' were devices that automatically decompressed and released [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droids]] from their withdrawn mode.

Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] purchased such a large amount of [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droids]] that it threatened to overrun [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] as their [[Unidentified freighter (Tatooine)|freighter]] arrived, he ostensibly used launchers to switch on the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] individually.
